tracking.consideration_before_proceeding: Sponsor intent mapped to checklist phases in writing using canonical vocabulary (fuzzy terms reworded; new concepts recorded); no implementation or test artifacts introduced; ready for formal change-definition.

Test written and run; test/identifier/fixture names resolved against the canonical vocabulary; block lead comment copied literally from IMPL; assertion matches pseudo-code OUTPUT/POST/FAILURE_MODES and setup satisfies PRE; failure reason honest (implementation gap, fixture, or brownfield baseline pass)—not wrong expected data.
Test passes; lint clean; new code symbols/storage names resolved from and recorded in the canonical vocabulary; block lead in production matches IMPL and test; token comments match pseudo-code block.
All bindings have IMPL coverage and composition tests; binding/channel/test names resolved from and recorded in the canonical vocabulary; tests and lint pass.
Risks and mitigations documented; token references attached.

Full suite and lint pass; post-test sub-pseudocode-validation-pass complete; token validation ok; three-way audit done; IMPL metadata updated; module validation documented; canonical vocabulary reconciled (RECORD) with final tests/code.

TIED docs match code/tests; tied_validate_consistency reports ok true; canonical vocabulary reconciled (RECORD) with final REQ/ARCH/IMPL, design/UI, and storage terms; ./tied/agent-preload-contract.yaml re-checked or explicitly unchanged if sync did not affect preload-relevant fields.
All blocks token-commented with canonical block names (resolved and recorded); dependencies and composition notes in place.

Change definition documented using canonical vocabulary (fuzzy terms reworded; new concepts recorded); current, desired, unchanged, non-goals, and success criteria stated; no implementation or test artifacts introduced in this step.
In-scope feature IMPL contracts cataloged; procedure/block names resolved from and recorded in the canonical vocabulary; methodology IMPLs handled per preconditions (no empty churn).
Test matrix and TDD plan complete; module boundaries identified.
No irreconcilable contradictions remain; or refactor completed.

All governing documents read; session context established; vocabulary term map loaded (PRELOAD) or deferral noted; mandatory IMPL→validation→persist→RED→GREEN sequence and implementation freeze understood.
E2E-only behavior identified and documented; UI-facing terms and E2E test names resolved from and recorded in the canonical vocabulary; E2E tests written and justified.
sub-vocabulary-sync (VALIDATE) passed or immature-client deferral noted; commit created; format per PROC-COMMIT_MESSAGES; tokens in body/footer.

ARCH index and detail files complete; design prose and ARCH/storage names resolved from canonical vocabulary and new design terms recorded; tokens in semantic-tokens.yaml; sub-yaml-edit-loop passed for all changed files; tied/agent-preload-contract.yaml updated after meaningful ARCH changes or explicitly skipped with reason.
REQ index and detail file complete; token name resolved from canonical vocabulary and concept<->token bridge recorded; token in semantic-tokens.yaml; sub-yaml-edit-loop passed for all changed files.
sub-pseudocode-validation-pass returned; pre-RED structural gate satisfied; test-dependent rows documented N/A if tests do not exist yet.
Insufficient specs identified; all flagged for resolution in resolve-pseudocode.

Impact map complete; vocabulary term map loaded (PRELOAD) for affected subsystems; IMPL inventory table built (declared vs in-scope verified paths distinguished; discovery-only); expansion stopped per criteria.
Refactor done; tests and lint still pass.
README/CHANGELOG updated when policy or goal requires (UI/release terms resolved from and recorded in the canonical vocabulary); otherwise explicitly skipped.
All flagged issues resolved; new/renamed logical units resolved from and recorded in the canonical vocabulary; no scope change pending or ARCH/REQ updated and returned.
CITDP record written and sub-yaml-edit-loop passed. Policy for when to create vs skip: ./tied/docs/citdp-policy.md.

Three-way alignment verified for iteration; all tokens in semantic-tokens.yaml; canonical vocabulary reconciled (RECORD) with this iteration's terms. If all required blocks for this change are covered (optional blocks explicitly deferred per REQ/change-definition—not REQ-mandated gaps), proceed per flow to composition-integration; else loop to unit-test-red only for uncovered required blocks.

IMPL index and detail files persisted; IMPL token and storage (code_locations/file/folder/schema) names resolved from and recorded in the canonical vocabulary; tokens registered; sub-yaml-edit-loop passed for all changed files; ./tied/agent-preload-contract.yaml updated or reconciled for IMPL-locked paths and constants.
Report persisted under working/{REQ-TOKEN}/adversarial-inquiry; caller receives summary; blocking only when caller blocking=true, strict-eligible, and error finding unresolved.

Gating rules pass or waiver documented; RETURN to gate-pseudocode-validation.

change_definition.current_behavior: Panorama passes most structural TIED validators and ~1,268 Vitest tests, but traceability_gap_report fails, Layer-B contract precision gaps remain on Active blocks, binding inventory is incomplete, and executable evidence is not_measured without a verification manifest.
change_definition.desired_behavior: P0 structural alignment (contracts + REQ test metadata), P1 composition inventory and risk-triggered QA matrix, and P2 verification manifest with integrated evidence-chain profile; all residual risks owned with expiry.
non_goals: No methodology YAML mutation under tied/methodology/
No new product features beyond alignment evidence
No human_research profile depth unless sponsor expands scope
success_criteria: Strict pseudocode_validate passes on in-scope Active blocks
traceability_gap_report passes or documented approved exceptions exist
binding_inventory_validate passes with composition or e2e_only justification per row
Verification manifest attached to integrated evidence-chain profile
tied_checklist_gate_validate allowed at verification and close_out phases
change_definition.unchanged_behavior: No alteration to Mesh API contracts, workspace navigation semantics, or persistence models unless a tranche explicitly fixes a documented defect.

completion_criteria.verification_gate_notes: Populate after each tranche; see test-strategy-outline.md

commands.command: pseudocode_validate IMPL-PANE_COMMAND_EXEC IMPL-FILE_PREVIEW IMPL-MESH_API IMPL-MESH_CONNECTOR IMPL-MESH_PERSISTENCE IMPL-MESH_INVENTORY require_contracts true

impact_analysis.impl_inventory_notes: Project TIED YAML and sidecars; Vitest unit and composition tests; client vocabulary; working/TIED-3.0-ALIGNMENT-SYNC artifacts. Methodology YAML read-only.
impact_analysis.modules_or_boundaries: tied/ project indexes and detail files; IMPL sidecars; src/ tests; tied/vocab/

tied_stack_updates_required: Persist final CITDP at close-out with verification command evidence
LEAP any tranche where tests/code diverge from updated IMPL sidecars

counterexamples: A sidecar block lacks PRE/POST/EFFECTS after a contract-precision tranche claims completion.
A REQ row gains test metadata pointing at a non-existent test file.
A binding inventory row names a composition test that does not fire the trigger programmatically.
disconfirming_observations: traceability_gap_report still failing without approved exceptions
strict pseudocode_validate reporting SHAPE-003..006 gaps on in-scope blocks
falsification_questions: Can traceability_gap_report detect REQ rows with fictional test paths?
Does strict pseudocode_validate fail when PRE/POST/EFFECTS are missing on touched Active blocks?
adversarial_inquiry.rationale: Documentation and traceability alignment retrofit; no runtime behavior change; no integrated eligibility triggers matched at refine-plan.

quality_evidence_matrix.command_or_test: bun run test; bunx tsc -b; bun run validate:vocabulary; pseudocode_validate; tied_validate_consistency; lint_yaml
quality_evidence_matrix.evidence_method: Project test suite, TypeScript build, vocabulary validation, strict pseudo-code validation, TIED consistency, YAML lint.
quality_evidence_matrix.limitation: Structural and executable checks do not prove unrelated security, performance, privacy, or usability properties.
quality_evidence_matrix.rationale: Every alignment tranche must preserve executable regression and TIED integrity.
quality_evidence_matrix.threshold: All required commands exit 0; structural validators pass or document approved exceptions.

residual_risk.summary: Pilot supplemental observations and large test counts are not completion proof until E3 manifest attach-provenance.

risks.description: Mass sidecar retrofit desynchronizes block leads from tests and code.
risks.mitigation: Three-way alignment; literal copy rule; LEAP on divergence.

risks.description: Traceability metadata backfill without honest test loci.
risks.mitigation: traceability_gap_report; waivers with owner and expiry in CITDP.

scenarios: A REQ row references a test file that does not import or assert the REQ behavior.
An inventory row marks e2e_only without a named platform constraint.

tdd_sequence.summary: Per tranche — IMPL pseudo-code and token comments first; gate-pseudocode-validation; unit-test-red/green when behavior touched; composition-integration for new inventory rows; verification-gate with manifest collection at E3.

test_strategy.matrix_notes: See working/TIED-3.0-ALIGNMENT-SYNC/test-strategy-outline.md for tranche matrix, commands bundle, and proof boundaries.
test_strategy.summary: P0 strict contract + traceability metadata; P1 binding inventory and risk-triggered QA; P2 verification manifest with integrated profile attach-provenance.
